summary: No advisory committee was convened for the original BLA125554 (OPDIVO/nivolumab) approval. All four original review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Office Director memo, and Medical Review) explicitly state the application was not referred to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) because nivolumab is not first-in-class, the clinical study design and efficacy outcome measures were acceptable, and no controversial safety or public-health issues required outside expertise. Consequently there was no AdComm vote and no AdComm-driven changes to the approval.
